findings.title: Preserve MANAGE_CLIENTS access to client role mappings
findings.body: These overrides check only the V2 permission and omit the `MANAGE_CLIENTS` role fallback provided by the existing client evaluator. As a result, administrators with the built-in `manage-clients` role can manage client configuration but are denied client-role mapping operations (and the same omission applies to the composite and client-scope mapping checks below). Preserve the existing role-based authorization when adding V2 permissions.

findings.title: Provision the Clients schema for existing admin-permissions clients
findings.body: The new Clients scopes and resource type are only written when `init` creates the admin-permissions client. `init` returns immediately when that client already exists, so realms upgraded with an existing V2 admin-permissions client retain only the old Users schema: the Clients resource and scopes are absent, and client permission creation/evaluation cannot work. Add an upgrade path that provisions missing schema elements for existing clients.
